goals.name: END_TO_END_AUTONOMY
goals.statement: Authorized objectives reach verified terminal outcomes with minimal human relay.

goals.name: HUMAN_INTERVENTION_ONLY_FOR_REAL_AUTHORITY
goals.statement: Routine engineering, recovery, testing and reconciliation proceed autonomously.

goals.name: CURRENT_TRUTH
goals.statement: Mutable decisions use freshly reconciled authoritative state.

goals.name: FAIL_CLOSED_TRUST
goals.statement: Ambiguous, stale, malformed or contradictory trust evidence cannot establish authority.

goals.name: EXACT_EVIDENCE
goals.statement: Authority-relevant results bind to exact identities, artifacts and executions.

goals.name: INDEPENDENT_ASSURANCE
goals.statement: Trust-impacting changes receive genuinely independent verification where required.

goals.name: SELF_REMEDIATION
goals.statement: Routine defects and failures are repaired autonomously within authority.

goals.name: CONTINUOUS_PROGRESS
goals.statement: Intermediate completion/external waits do not create avoidable stalls.

goals.name: SAFE_CONCURRENCY
goals.statement: Parallel agents preserve ownership, leases, CAS and evidence identity.

goals.name: PRODUCTION_PRESERVATION
goals.statement: Production remains unchanged until explicit production authority.

goals.name: NO_CERTIFICATION_TRANSFER
goals.statement: Certification remains bound to the exact object verified.

goals.name: DURABLE_KNOWLEDGE
goals.statement: Decisions, evidence, residuals and recovery remain machine-readable and durable.

goals.name: REDUCE_FUTURE_OPERATOR_WORK
goals.statement: Repeated manual operations become safe reusable automation.

goals.name: MINIMAL_NECESSARY_CONSTRAINT
goals.statement: Directives specify outcomes and invariants rather than unnecessary procedures.

goals.name: TERMINAL_OUTCOME_OR_PRECISE_FRONTIER
goals.statement: Every mission ends in verified success or one precise external frontier.
